title: Paley-Zygmund forbids spectral concentration: F2 holds only by sign-cancellation, the open core is phase-only
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley: B = max_{b!=0}||eta_b|| (the non-principal generalized-Paley eigenvalue) is a MAGNITUDE that the proven moments do not constrain; it is determined by phase interference among the m Gauss-period summands, which IS the 25-year-open BGK/Paley-graph object.
evidence: Two exact/high-precision probes on PROPER dyadic subgroups mu_n < F_q* in the prize regime (n=8 q=521 beta=3.01; n=16 q=4129 beta=3.00; n=32 q=5857 beta=2.50; n=64 q=32833 beta=2.50; n<<sqrt(q)). The connection's PROVEN kernel is real: card_resonant_ge (Paley-Zygmund) + prize_levelset_sharp bracket the COUNT of resonant freqs at the sqrt(n) scale to Theta(q), and card_johnson_scale_frequencies_le_min caps #{||eta_b||^2>=q}<=min(n,E/q) -- both landed axiom-clean. But the HEADLINE decoupling claim -- 'magnitudes pinned by F5(E2=3n^2-3n)/F7(Parseval), only the phase of the worst eta_b is open' -- is FALSE. (P1, C060_magnitude_pinned.py) Fixing the EXACT proven moments M1=sum||eta_b||^2=q*n and M2=sum||eta_b||^4=q*(3n^2-3n), the largest max_b||eta_b|| compatible with them ranges over [0, ~q^(1/4)*sqrt(n)] (n=8:[0,15.5]; n=16:[0,37.4]; n=32:[0,63.4]; n=64:[0,138.3]) vs trueB=6.56/11.14/20.03/32.55 and flat sqrt(n)=2.83/4/5.66/8. The two moments DO NOT pin the magnitude profile: the worst-case magnitude is free over a wide interval the moments cannot narrow. (Cross-check: the 4th-moment Markov ceiling on the SINGLE worst freq is exactly (q*E2)^(1/4) ~ q^(1/4)*sqrt(n) = 17.2/41.5/64.6/141.2, matching maxprof_hi and GROWING with beta -- the vacuous magnitude freedom.) (P2, C060_phase_vs_magnitude.py) B=max_b||eta_b|| is the MAX OF THE MAGNITUDE PROFILE by definition, so 'magnitudes pinned, only phase open' is self-contradictory unless the profile is unpinned (it is). And the 'phase' invoked (Gauss-period args chi-bar(b)tau(chi)) is exactly what DETERMINES each ||eta_b||: holding the magnitudes |tau|=sqrt(q) fixed (the proven part) and randomizing only phases makes |sum of n unit phasors| swing from ~0 to ~n (n=32: [0.08,12.0], flat=5.66) -- magnitude IS a phase-interference functional, not a separable pinned layer.
honest_note: The connection correctly read two genuinely-landed two-sided bricks (card_resonant_ge / prize_levelset_sharp in PrizeSpectralLevelSetSharp.lean, and card_johnson_scale_frequencies_le_min in SubgroupGaussSumAntiConc.lean); the Paley-Zygmund Omega(q) lower bound forcing positive density at sqrt(n) is real and the COUNT bracketing is sound -- that PARTIAL content is true and already in-tree. What is REFUTED is the strengthening to a magnitude/phase DECOUPLING ('F2 = proven magnitude + open phase', 'magnitude already determined'): (a) those identities pin only AGGREGATE moments (sum and sum-of-squares of magnitudes over the q frequencies), never the per-frequency magnitude, and in particular leave the single worst-case B free over [0, ~q^(1/4)*sqrt(n)] -- the worst-case magnitude is exactly the unconstrained object (same lesson as the refuted C045 'Var=n is blind to B'); (b) the worst-case B is itself a MAGNITUDE, so 'phase-only open' is incoherent -- the attack_plan's premise ('fix the proven magnitude profile {||eta_b||^2} and vary only phases') is impossible because B is the max of that profile, and the profile is not fixed; (c) the Gauss-period phases the connection isolates as 'the only open part' are precisely what determines the magnitudes, so this is not a smaller/cleaner target -- it is a relabeling of the full BGK/Paley wall. Add to DISPROOF_LOG.md as a refuted route ('the proven 2nd/4th moments pin only aggregate magnitude moments, NOT the per-frequency magnitude; B is a magnitude determined by the open phase interference, so F2 does not decouple into proven-magnitude + open-phase'). Probes are exact-integer for the closed-form moments (M1=q*n) and high-precision complex for the true spectra at small n; not a Lean lemma. Welds back to W-BGK (open).
